content:
We're bringing you an early edition of "Lunch Break" today, thanks to 9to5Toys — AirPods Pro 3 are back on sale, with Amazon dropping the price by nearly 25%, making it one of the best deals we've seen this year.

Last month's "Black Friday in July" early bird deals have been rolling right into August, with Amazon consistently offering a solid $50 off. But now AirPods Pro 3 are back down to $189.99 with free shipping.

That's $59 off the regular $249 price, for a discount of nearly 25%.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (regularly $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (regularly $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (regularly $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $149 (regularly $179)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (regularly $179 new) — Renewed Premium

New AirPods could land as soon as next month, but it's going to be a long time before they see deals like these. While they may be the only major new Apple product launching in the next month or so that's not affected by "RAMageddon," the built-in cameras rumored to be added this year will almost certainly push pricing much higher.

So if you're looking to spend $300 or more on a pair of "rearview mirrors" for your ears, you may want to wait.

Today's AirPods Pro 3 deals come amid major Apple Shopping Events at retailers across the board. Beyond AirPods, there's plenty of other great deals to shop right now, including unlocked iPhone Air price drops, MacBook Neo discounts, Apple Watch Ultra 3 deals up to $130 off, and much more.
